detail.longDescription: I'm currently trying to complete a course assignment in Rust from a course from 2020 that I'm going through. https://github.com/reberhardt7/cs110l-spr-2020-starter-code/blob/main/week1/part-3-hangman/src/main.rs : this is the original version of the file that I am attempting to run. error[E0463]: can't find crate for `rand` --> main.rs:15:1 | 15 | extern crate rand; | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ can't find crate I get the above issue when I try to import rand. rand is in my Cargo.toml file. See below: [package] name = "hangman" version = "0.1.0" authors = ["Armin Namavari <arminn@stanford.edu>"] [dependencies] rand = "0.6.5" I am aware that in newer versions of Rust, I am not required to have the extern crate rand line, so I tried to run the code without that, to no success. I am currently running Rust 1.71.0, released on 7-12-23. I am using the Run Code button in VS Code, which does the following command in the terminal: cd "/Users/milansuresh/cs1 10l-spr-2020-starter-code/week1/part-3-hangman/src/" && rustc main.rs && "/Users/milansuresh/cs110l-spr-2020-starter-code/week1/part-3-hangman/src/"main
